_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_mechanics#9 (DENS is a REQUIRED parameter of MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff even for DYNAMICTYPE: Statics — the frequent advice that density 'is only needed for dynamics' is about whether the VALUE matters, not whether the KEY may be omitted) and #10 (NUE is validated against the half-open range [-1, 0.5), so the incompressible limit NUE: 0.5 is rejected outright rather than merely ill-conditioned). The parameter specs are in src/global_legacy_module/4C_global_legacy_module_validmaterials.cpp; neither has a default.
